children: THL LAUNCHES SALE OF APPROXIMATELY 103 MILLION SHARES OF AUTOSTORE HOLDINGS LTD.
SALE REPRESENTS 3.0% OF AUTOSTORE ISSUED AND OUTSTANDING SHARES
SALE REPRESENTS SELLDOWN OF 10.8% OF THL'S AUTOSTORE STAKE
THL TO HOLD 853 MILLION AUTOSTORE SHARES, 24.9% OF SHARE CAPITAL AFTER SALE
SALE PRICE AND FINAL SHARE COUNT TO BE ANNOUNCED BEFORE MARKET OPEN ON SEPT 9, 2026
